purpose: prevent model-response fabrication from becoming formal acceptance evidence while permitting explicitly isolated pseudo-live responses for offline optimization

result_eligibility.synthetic_model_response: allowed only in PSEUDO_LIVE_OPTIMIZATION as PSEUDO_LIVE_SYNTHETIC; never formal acceptance evidence
result_eligibility.missing_provenance: fail_closed_for_acceptance_only; development scoring remains available with explicit offline_conformance tier
result_eligibility.zero_substitution: forbidden for acceptance_score; unavailable acceptance stays null
result_eligibility.development_scoring: development_score remains available for valid exact-lineage offline_conformance/pseudo-live evidence; this never creates acceptance eligibility
result_eligibility.acceptance_scoring: requires LIVE_ACCEPTANCE + PASS formal provenance; pseudo score can never populate formal fields
result_eligibility.model_call_requirement: model calls are required only for model nodes actually executed by the path; a deterministic zero-model path may be formally eligible

forbidden: hand-authored expected model response used as if generated
manual or helper repair outside declared graph
changing frozen model response after observing output or score
separation: response simulator, provenance verifier, result evaluator, and optimizer are separate responsibilities; simulator cannot see evaluator-only references/target score/ranking and verifier/evaluator cannot author replacement responses

PSEUDO_LIVE_OPTIMIZATION.pseudo_score_eligible: yes when all pseudo provenance + artifact lineage checks PASS

LIVE_ACCEPTANCE.formal_score_eligible: yes when all required executed model responses + artifact lineage checks PASS
